text_en: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
text_cn: 那时，耶稣被圣神领往旷野，为受魔鬼的试探。

text_en: He fasted forty days and forty nights, and afterwards he was famished.
text_cn: 他四十天四十夜禁食，后来就饿了。

text_en: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become loaves of bread. ”
text_cn: 试探者就前来对他说：“你若是天主子，就命这些石头变成饼罢！”

text_en: But he answered, “It is written, ‘One does not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God. ’”
text_cn: 他回答说：“经上记载：‘人生活不只靠饼，而也靠天主口中所发的一切言语。’”

text_en: Then the devil took him to the holy city and placed him on the pinnacle of the temple,
text_cn: 那时，魔鬼引他到了圣城，把他立在殿顶上，

text_en: saying to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down; for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you, ’ and ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you will not dash your foot against a stone. ’”
text_cn: 对他说：“你若是天主子，就跳下去，因经上记载：‘他为你吩咐了自己的天使，他们要用手托着你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。’”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Again it is written, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test. ’”
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“经上又记载：‘你不可试探上主，你的天主！’”

text_en: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor;
text_cn: 魔鬼又把他带到一座极高的山上，将世上的一切国度及其荣华指给他看，

text_en: and he said to him, “All these I will give you, if you will fall down and worship me. ”
text_cn: 对他说：“你若俯伏朝拜我，我必把这一切交给你。”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Away with you, Satan! for it is written, ‘Worship the Lord your God, and serve only him. ’”
text_cn: 那时，耶稣就对他说：“去吧！撒殚！因为经上记载：‘你要朝拜上主，你的天主，惟独事奉他。’”

text_en: Then the devil left him, and suddenly angels came and waited on him.
text_cn: 于是魔鬼离开了他，就有天使前来伺候他。

text_en: Now when Jesus heard that John had been arrested, he withdrew to Galilee.
text_cn: 耶稣听到若翰被监禁以后，就退避到加里肋亚去了；

text_en: He left Nazareth and made his home in Capernaum by the sea, in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali,
text_cn: 后又离开纳匝肋，来住在海边的葛法翁，即住在则步隆和纳斐塔里境内。

text_en: so that what had been spoken through the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled:
text_cn: 这应验了依撒意亚先知所说的话：

text_en: “Land of Zebulun, land of Naphtali, on the road by the sea, across the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
text_cn: “则步隆地与纳斐塔里地，通海大路，约但河东，外方人的加里肋亚，

text_en: the people who sat in darkness have seen a great light, and for those who sat in the region and shadow of death light has dawned. ”
text_cn: 那坐在黑暗中的百姓，看见了浩光；那些坐在死亡阴影之地的人，为他们出现了光明。”

text_en: From that time Jesus began to proclaim, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near. ”
text_cn: 从那时起，耶稣开始宣讲说：“你们悔改吧！因为天国临近了。”

text_en: As he walked by the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea—for they were fishermen.
text_cn: 耶稣沿加里肋亚海行走时，看见了两个兄弟：称为伯多禄的西满，和他的兄弟安德肋，在海里撒网，他们原是渔夫。

text_en: And he said to them, “Follow me, and I will make you fish for people. ”
text_cn: 他就对他们说：“来，跟从我！我要使你们成为渔人的渔夫。”

text_en: Immediately they left their nets and followed him.
text_cn: 他们立刻舍下网，跟随了他。

text_en: As he went from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John, in the boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets, and he called them.
text_cn: 他从那里再往前行，看见了另外两个兄弟：载伯德的儿子雅各伯和他的弟弟若望，在船上同自己的父亲载伯德修理他们的网，就召叫了他们。

text_en: Immediately they left the boat and their father, and followed him.
text_cn: 他们也立刻舍下鱼船和自己的父亲，跟随了他。

text_en: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom and curing every disease and every sickness among the people.
text_cn: 耶稣走遍了全加里肋亚，在他们的会堂内施教，宣讲天国的福音，治好民间各种疾病，各种灾殃。

text_en: So his fame spread throughout all Syria, and they brought to him all the sick, those who were afflicted with various diseases and pains, demoniacs, epileptics, and paralytics, and he cured them.
text_cn: 他的名声传遍了整个叙利亚。人就把一切有病的、受各种疾病痛苦煎熬的、附魔的，癫痫的、瘫痪的，都给他送来，他都治好了他们。

text_en: And great crowds followed him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan.
text_cn: 于是有许多群众从加里肋亚、“十城区”、耶路撒冷、犹太和约但河东岸来跟随了他。
